name: talkcheck-verified-agent
description: Source-aware Korean business verification and tax invoice handoff for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Verify Korean businesses with visible evidence.
interface.longDescription: Turn a Korean business number or registration certificate into a field-level evidence report, resolve conflicts conversationally, and prepare a short-lived tax invoice confirmation handoff without automatic issuance.
defaultPrompt: 이 사업자등록증의 정보와 국세청 조회 결과를 대조해 줘.
거래처 사업자 정보를 확인하고 세금계산서 초안을 준비해 줘.
